"""Remove one production guard call in memory, then run its liveness witness."""
import ast
import inspect
from pathlib import Path
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(root/'tests'))
import test_lan_leaf_rotation_consecutive as fixture
import pytest

kind = sys.argv[1]
module = fixture.rotation if kind == 'node' else fixture.lan_pilot
name = '_finalized_successor' if kind == 'node' else '_finalized_predecessor'
tree = ast.parse(inspect.getsource(getattr(module, name)))

class RemoveGuard(ast.NodeTransformer):
    count = 0
    def visit_Expr(self, node):
        if isinstance(node.value, ast.Call):
            function = node.value.func
            called = function.id if isinstance(function, ast.Name) else getattr(function,'attr','')
            if called == '_require_settled_archive':
                self.count += 1
                return None
        return self.generic_visit(node)

remove = RemoveGuard()
tree = remove.visit(tree)
assert remove.count == 1, 'must remove exactly the selected entry point guard'
exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(tree), module.__file__, 'exec'), module.__dict__)
target = 'node' if kind == 'node' else 'cp'
raise SystemExit(pytest.main([f'tests/test_rotation_predecessor_residue.py::test_{target}_successor_requires_verified_predecessor_replay','-q','-p','no:cacheprovider']))
